observation.visible_scene: A wide, shallow metal bowl sits on a concrete floor outdoors at night. In the center of the bowl is a small mound of brown pellet-like material with a bright yellow-orange flame burning on top of it, surrounded by rising pale smoke/steam. Three men watch from around the bowl: one crouching at left in a black shirt and cream trousers, one standing at center in cream trousers and orange sandals, and one crouching at right in a white shirt and black trousers holding a smartphone. A metal railing and a low white wall are behind them.
visible_changes: The camera framing gradually widens/pulls back over the first half of the clip, revealing more of the men's bodies and the railing behind them.

Around the middle of the clip the ambient/electric lighting is extinguished, and the scene becomes very dark, with the flame becoming the dominant light source that casts an orange glow on the bowl and faintly illuminates the men as silhouettes.
The flame flickers and shifts shape in place throughout, and the smoke/steam plume above it varies in intensity.
The three men remain largely stationary in their crouching/standing positions relative to the bowl across the whole excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: What ignited the pile and what the pellet material is.
Why the surrounding light was switched off (intentional or automatic).
Whether the pile is consumed or grows after this segment, and the eventual outcome of the burn.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent widening is a true zoom/dolly or a slight repositioning of the camera.
Whether the mound of pellets visibly shrinks during the burn (lighting changes make size comparison unreliable).
Exact identity of the burning material and the source of the smoke.
